title: The Cellar Door
journal: Never-Writes-Twice says Fort Chalkmoth is a fort like any other, but a wounded Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in its cellar. This is my own errand, not the order's; the order's hunt waits at Bell Station, and either may come first. Fort Chalkmoth is the Archwardens' fort on the Chixathe Mesa above Noota Nara. I want to get into the fort and see its cellar. Who goes into the keep is for the wall captain at the gate to say. A quiet visitor might find another way in, but the garrison will attack anyone it catches inside without leave.
objectives: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, by the wall captain's leave or unseen. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan)

plan.going: This is my own errand, to see what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth; the order's hunt, at Bell Station, is open beside it and either may come first.
plan.next: Get into Fort Chalkmoth's keep, on the mesa above Noota Nara.
plan.ways: Ask the wall captain at the gate for leave (the marked way), or look for a way in unseen; the trapdoor in the yard behind the barracks is there to be found, unmarked and not locked.

answers: I am Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. A hurt Unbound scout told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, an Archwarden fort. The order hunt for the Eye of Argonia at the Root waits at Bell Station, but this is my own errand first.
Get into the keep of Fort Chalkmoth and see its cellar, starting with the wall captain Sakeeus-Wan at the gate.
Ask the captain for leave to enter, or find a quiet way in unseen; the garrison will attack anyone caught inside without leave. The keep door is locked and I have lockpicks.
I do not know what moans in the cellar, nor what the Root and Eye truly are. I could find out by seeing the cellar and by talking to people.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: The wall captain, Sakeeus-Wan, says a Toh-Wo may sleep in the barracks, but the keep stays shut to strangers while three Sarpa raiders rob the chalk carts on the western approach. If I kill the three raiders, he will open the keep and pay me. I could still look for a way in unseen instead.
objectives: Kill the three Sarpa raiders on Fort Chalkmoth's western approach. (marker: Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider, Sarpa Raider)
Tell the wall captain the raiders are dead. (marker: Sakeeus-Wan)

plan.going: The captain will open the keep once the raiders on the western approach are dead.
plan.next: Kill the three Sarpa raiders, then tell the captain.
plan.ways: Fight the raiders (any weapon or magic), or skip the captain and go in by the trapdoor unseen.

answers: The captain Sakeeus-Wan keeps the keep shut while three Sarpa raiders rob chalk carts on the western approach. He will open the keep and pay 100 gold if I kill them.
Kill the three Sarpa raiders on the western approach, then report to Sakeeus-Wan.
Fight the raiders for the captain, or look for a quiet way in unseen (lockpick the keep door), risking the garrison.
I do not know who the Sarpa are beyond raiders; the captain has a topic about them I can ask.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: I killed the Sarpa raiders, and the wall captain gave me the key to the keep and a hundred gold. The stair down to the cellar starts in the quartermaster's store, inside the keep, behind a good lock; the Dunmer quartermaster, Theyne Indarys, carries its key. The captain warned me that his leave covers the keep, not the store. I can pick the lock or lift the key, and if I am caught at either the garrison will treat me as a thief; or I can ask Theyne to open it, with good words or with gold.
objectives: Look at the stack of sap jars by the cellar stair in the quartermaster's store. (marker: Door to Quartermaster's Store, Theyne Indarys, Stack of Sap Jars (Jal-Veesa Knot))
Speak to the gaoler at the foot of the cellar stair. (marker: Tsleel-Vaku)
Try the cellar door. (marker: Door to Cellar Door)

plan.going: I am in the keep by the captain's leave. The cellar stair starts in the quartermaster's store.
plan.next: Three things, in any order: look in the store, speak to the gaoler at the stair's foot, try the cellar door.
plan.ways: Talk the quartermaster round (Speech) or pay him 150 gold for the store's key; or pick the store's Adept lock or lift his key, where being caught makes me a thief to the garrison; persuade the gaoler or test him with Illusion for more (optional). A theft seen, or an attack on the gaoler, sets the garrison on me.
terms: Jal-Veesa's knot: the jar's name and text; the quartermaster's line
the gaoler: his line: a gaoler of the Toh-Reel-Ka who keeps the inner door

answers: I killed the raiders; the captain gave me the keep key and 100 gold. The cellar stair is in the quartermaster store, whose key Theyne Indarys holds.
Go into the keep and the quartermaster store, look at the sap jars (Jal-Veesa Knot), speak to gaoler Tsleel-Vaku at the stair foot, try the cellar door.
Ask Theyne to open the store with words or gold, pick the lock, or lift the key; being caught makes me a thief.
I do not know what Jal-Veesa Knot means, nor what moans in the cellar. I can ask Theyne and the gaoler.

title: The Cellar Door
journal: Jars of Hist sap tied with the knot of the tree-minder of Jal-Veesa, the town whose sick Hist I first saw, are stacked by the cellar stair, in a fort with no Hist of its own. The order's gaoler turned me away from the inner door, Toh-Wo or not. He said Never-Writes-Twice has its key. Behind the door, something moans. Who is down there, and why the order feeds them sap, I cannot learn here. Back to the order's hunt: the drowned tower that Bell Station's divers know.

plan.going: The cellar holds people who moan behind a locked door, fed on sap from Jal-Veesa; Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key; why is an open question.
plan.next: Go back to the hunt at Bell Station, east of Lilmoth.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka as Secret-Speaker of the order. In Fort Chalkmoth I found jars of Hist sap tied with Jal-Veesa tree-minder knots stacked by the cellar stair, in a fort with no Hist. The order gaoler Tsleel-Vaku will not open the cellar; Never-Writes-Twice holds the key. Something moans behind the door.
Return to the order hunt: go to Bell Station off Lilmoth and ask the divers which drowned tower is cut deeper.
Bell Station first; or confront Never-Writes-Twice about the cellar key, or pick the cellar door lock (the gaoler stands there).
I do not know who or what is in the cellar or why the order feeds them sap; I could ask Never-Writes-Twice or find the key.
